import PrioQueue.Spec
namespace PrioQueue

instance instDecidableValid (s : State) (op : Op) : Decidable (Valid s op) := by
  cases op <;> unfold Valid Sorted <;> infer_instance

def ins (e : Entry) : List Entry → List Entry
  | [] => [e]
  | x :: xs => if e.prio < x.prio then e :: x :: xs else x :: ins e xs

def step : Impl := fun s op =>
  if Valid s op then
    match op with
    | .insert e => (.ok, { s with items := ins e s.items })
    | .pop =>
      match s.items with
      | [] => (.rejected, s)
      | x :: xs => (.got x, { s with items := xs })
  else (.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop   : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_capacity       : CapacityBound step := sorry
theorem req_pop_min        : PopMin step := sorry
theorem req_sorted         : KeepsSorted step := sorry
theorem req_insert_effects : InsertEffects step := sorry
theorem req_pop_effects    : PopEffects step := sorry
theorem req_fifo_ties      : FifoTies step := sorry

end PrioQueue

lemma ins_length (e : Entry) (l : List Entry) : (ins e l).length = l.length + 1 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [ins]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp [ins]
    split
    · simp
    · simp [ih, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm]

theorem req_capacity : CapacityBound step := by
  intro s op hle
  unfold step
  split
  · next hV =>
    cases op with
    | insert e =>
      simp only
      have hlen : (ins e s.items).length = s.items.length + 1 := ins_length e s.items
      -- need to show ins length ≤ capacity
      -- from hV we have Valid: Sorted ∧ length < capacity
      have hValid : Valid s (Op.insert e) := hV
      unfold Valid at hValid
      have hlt : s.items.length < s.capacity := hValid.2
      have hle2 : s.items.length + 1 ≤ s.capacity := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt
      simp [hlen, hle2]
    | pop =>
      simp only
      -- Valid pop: Sorted ∧ ≠ []
      -- need to show length of tail ≤ capacity
      -- s.items = x :: xs
      cases hitems : s.items with
      | nil =>
        -- then Valid would be false because ≠ []
        have hValid : Valid s Op.pop := hV
        unfold Valid at hValid
        have hne : s.items ≠ [] := hValid.2
        rw [hitems] at hne
        contradiction
      | cons hd tl =>
        simp [hitems]
        have : tl.length ≤ s.items.length := by simp [hitems]
        omega
  · simp [hle]

theorem req_pop_min : PopMin step := by
  intro s h
  unfold step at h
  split at h
  · next hV =>
    cases hitems : s.items with
    | nil =>
      -- Valid implies not empty, but we are in the Valid branch, pop on nil would give rejected, contradict h
      -- Actually when s.items = [], the match inside returns (.rejected, s)
      -- So need to show h is false
      have eq : (match ([] : List Entry) with | [] => (Outcome.rejected, s) | x :: xs => (Outcome.got x, { s with items := xs })) = (Outcome.rejected, s) := rfl
      -- Need to rewrite step evaluation
      have hstep : step s Op.pop = (Outcome.rejected, s) := by
        unfold step
        simp [hV, hitems]
      rw [hstep] at h
      simp at h
    | cons hd tl =>
      have hstep : step s Op.pop = (Outcome.got hd, { s with items := tl }) := by
        unfold step
        simp [hV, hitems]
      rw [hstep]
      refine ⟨hd, rfl, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      simp at hx
      -- need to use Sorted
      have hSorted : Sorted s.items := by
        have : Valid s Op.pop := hV
        unfold Valid at this
        exact this.1
      rw [hitems] at hSorted
      -- Sorted (hd :: tl) means Pairwise ≤
      -- Want to show hd.prio ≤ x.prio for x ∈ tl
      -- Use pairwise property: hd ≤ each element of tl ?
      -- Pairwise implies that.
      have hpair : ∀ y ∈ tl, hd.prio ≤ y.prio := by
        -- unfold Sorted
        unfold Sorted at hSorted
        -- Pairwise (· ≤ ·) on hd::tl gives Forall + Pairwise tail and hd ≤ each
        -- Use List.pairwise_cons.mp
        have hp := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hSorted)
        have hforall : ∀ y ∈ tl, (fun a b => a.prio ≤ b.prio) hd y := hp.1
        intro y hy
        exact hforall y hy
      exact hpair x hx
  · next hV =>
    -- Invalid branch gives (rejected, s) so h false
    have hstep : step s Op.pop = (Outcome.rejected, s) := by
      unfold step
      simp [hV]
    rw [hstep] at h
    simp at h
